name: Akhevan Dais
description: The Akhevan Dais is the ceremonial heart of Ka Vethan, where Praesertum decrees are proclaimed and lineage rituals are performed. A towering platform of Luclinite stone and void‑arcane channels, the Dais serves as both a political stage and a ritual nexus. Citizens gather here to witness governance, while Akhevan elites conduct rites of authority and resonance alignment.
